title.en: Seijo ga "Amayakashite Kureru Yasashii Danna-sama" wo Boshuu Shitara Kokuou Heika ga Rikkouho Shite Kita
Saijoukyuu no Seijorashii desu ga, Ryuuou-sama no Hanayome ni wa narimasen! - Tsuihousareta no de Kusushi to shite Daini no Jinsei wo Oukashimasu
Mujikaku Seijo wa Kyou mo Muishiki ni Chikara wo Tarenagasu
Seijo no Maryoku wa Bannou desu
Karappo Seijo to shite Suterareta Hazu ga, Totsugi-saki no Koutei Heika ni Dekiaisareteimasu
Because I, the True Saint, Was Banished, That Country Is Done for!
Watashi, Seijo. Ima, Kankinsarete Iru no
Tensei Reijou, Kekkon no Susume - Akujo ga Gimai no Kawari ni Totsuidanara
Migawari Konyaku Shananoni, Gin Ookami Heika ga Doushitemo Hanashite Kuremasen!
Kamiyui Otome no Yomeiri - Mukae ni Kita Danna-sama to, Kamisama ni Otsukae shimasu.
Kusuri de Osanaku Natta Okage de Reikoku Koushaku-sama ni Hirowaremashita - Suterare Seijo wa Renkinjutsushi ni Modorimasu
Honmono no Seijo Janai to Bareta no ni, Outei Denka ni Semararete imasu
Watashi wa Nise Seijo Rashii no de, Kyuutei wo Dete Ringoku de Kurashimasu
Ochibure Saijo no Koufuku Heika ni Suterareta no de, Saiai no Hito wo Sukui ni ikimasu
Kono Ai wa, Kokuou Heika no Gomeirei Janai - Ohitori-sama Kibou no Reijou desu ga, Funaka na Kishi ga Hanashitekuremasen!
